observations.seen: The daytime frames read as flat ambient fill. No clear 3/4 front sun direction shows on the cottage walls, the windmill tower or the character. The hooded figure has almost no form shading and blends into the grass. The dusk frame (4) changes the mood mainly through tint and fog, not through a directional key.

The character casts no visible shadow on the path. The cottage, trees, signpost and windmill have little or no ground contact shadow. The bushes and flowers have no self-shadowing, so everything floats on the green ground plane.

The lake shows a sky-tinted surface with ripple streaks and a faint shimmer. It does not reflect the cottage or the shoreline trees. Every other surface is uniformly matte with no environment response.

Distance haze lifts the far shore in frames 1–3. Frame 4 adds heavier pink fog and drifting specks or fireflies. A vertical light shaft beside the windmill in frame 2 reads more like an artifact than a deliberate god ray.

The roof tiles and wooden windmill planks have decent stylized texture. The bushes reuse an identical polka-dot berry pattern everywhere. The white lupines and grass edges show screen-door or dither noise, which turns them into speckled pixels.

The cottage, with its chimney, ivy and arched doors, and the windmill, with its railing, ladder and sails, are well built. The far shoreline trees and lighthouse are flat billboard cards on a painted backdrop. The character model looks different between frames, a green cloak in 1–2 and a grey, more realistic robe in 3–4, and reads as low detail at this scale.

The subject sits near center but has the same hue as the surrounding grass, so it disappears. The bottom half of every frame is undifferentiated foreground foliage. Large leaf meshes intrude at the top-left corner of frames 1, 3 and 4, and windmill fragments clip the right edge.

The camera is a low third-person chase view from behind, not the side-on follow the platformer recipe calls for. Tall grass occludes the character's legs. The character fills roughly 10–15% of frame height in frames 3–4, below the 18–25% target, and foliage clips the near plane.

There is mild bloom on the bright signboard near the windmill. Dither or alpha-to-coverage noise is visible around the character and the white flowers. Grading jumps from saturated midday (1–2) to washed lavender (3) to muddy pink (4) with no consistent daylight-outdoor look.
Static frames show a mid-stride walk pose and a taut kite string to a kite above the cottage. The poses read as stiff. The cloak shows no visible secondary motion.

nextChange.change: raise shadow strength toward the look target and pull the key light to an angle that throws visible contact shadows
